name: Hitozuma Osananajimi to Kin'ai NTR~Saikai. Soshite, Kozukuri e~
original_name: 人妻幼なじみと禁愛NTR～再会。そして、子作りへ～
source:
"......Making a face like that, it's not fair."

At a dating agency, I reunited with Kei. I was a client who she was in charge of. A ring glinted on the left hand of my childhood friend.

After talking about each other's life up to now at an [i]izakaya[/i], I took her to her home while she was drunk.

A splendid house, photos of a married couple, fertility drugs. My heart ached seeing the reality before me.

"It's time for me to――"

When I was about to leave, she grabbed my arm――

Only for a short while, but it's fine. Even if this becomes the worst act, it does not matter.
......With the first person whom I fell in love with, if this can make us fall in love again.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1219676]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“……露出那种表情，太狡猾了。”

在婚介所，我与慧重逢了。我是由她负责的客户。青梅竹马的左手上，一枚戒指闪着光。

我们在[i]居酒屋[/i]聊起彼此这些年的生活，之后，我将喝醉的她送回了家。

气派的房子，夫妻合照，助孕药。眼前的现实，刺痛了我的心。

“我也差不多该——”

正要告辞时，她抓住了我的手臂——

哪怕只有短短片刻，也没有关系。就算这是最卑劣的行为，也无所谓。
……如果能与初恋的那个人，再次相爱。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1219676]Getchu[/url]并经编辑]
